![Abstract Security](https://cybersecurity-excellence-awards.com/wp-content/uploads/163661.png)

# ABSTRACT SECURITY
**The Security Data Pipeline Platform.** Send detection-ready data straight into Microsoft Sentinel — normalized, enriched, cost-optimized.

[abstract.security](https://abstract.security) · [Documentation](https://docs.abstractsecurity.app/docs/integrations/destination-integrations/azure-sentinel-destination/)

---
### Azure Sentinel — Destination Integration (one-click app registration)
This deployment creates the ingestion stack and an Entra app registration for Abstract. Choose a new Key Vault, an existing Key Vault, or no Key Vault. With no Key Vault, this deployment does **not** create a client secret; create it in Entra after deployment and copy it once into Abstract.

⚠️ **Prerequisites:** the provisioning identity needs the Microsoft Graph application permission `Application.ReadWrite.All` (not `AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All`), granted with admin consent by a Global Administrator once per tenant. The deploying principal needs **Owner** (or **Contributor + User Access Administrator**) on the deployment resource group.

The app registration is Abstract's runtime identity; the supplied managed identity is only the provisioning runner. The template grants the runtime service principal both **Monitoring Metrics Publisher** and **Monitoring Contributor** on the DCR.

elements.name: mode
elements.label: Log Analytics workspace
elements.toolTip: Create a fresh workspace (and enable Sentinel on it), or target an existing workspace in THIS resource group.

allowedValues.label: Use an existing workspace (in this resource group)

elements.name: workspaceNameNew
elements.label: New workspace name (leave empty to auto-generate)
elements.toolTip: 4-63 chars, letters/numbers/hyphens. Empty = auto-generated (abstract-sentinel-<hash>).

constraints.validationMessage: 4-63 chars, letters/numbers/hyphens, or empty to auto-generate.

elements.name: workspaceNameExisting
elements.label: Existing workspace name
elements.toolTip: The exact name of an existing Log Analytics workspace in this resource group.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the exact existing workspace name (4-63 chars).

elements.name: existingWorkspaceLocation
elements.label: Existing workspace region
elements.toolTip: The Azure region of the existing workspace (e.g. eastus2). The DCE and DCR must be created in the SAME region as the workspace. Leave empty only if the workspace is in this deployment's region.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the workspace region short name (e.g. eastus, westeurope), or leave empty.

elements.name: workspaceRetentionDays
elements.label: Workspace retention (days)
elements.toolTip: Applied when creating a new workspace.

elements.name: workspaceSku
elements.label: Workspace pricing tier
elements.toolTip: PerGB2018 is the recommended pay-as-you-go tier. Change advanced pricing options in the Bicep parameters if required.

elements.name: enableSentinel
elements.label: Enable Microsoft Sentinel on the new workspace

options.text: Creates a Data Collection Endpoint, a custom *_CL table, and a Data Collection Rule that routes Abstract's stream into the table. The table has one column per top-level key of the Abstract Common Schema event, which is how the Abstract Azure Sentinel Destination sends it: nested objects are dynamic columns, and the rule's transformation sets TimeGenerated and stores the reserved id and type keys as acs_id and acs_type. Leave the columns field as [] unless you send a custom payload shape. The DCR stream name is 'Custom-<table name>' — enter that exact value as the 'Log Stream Name' in Abstract.

elements.name: customTableName
elements.label: Custom log table name
elements.toolTip: Must end in _CL. The Abstract 'Log Stream Name' will be Custom-<this value>.

constraints.validationMessage: Letters, numbers and underscores; must start with a letter and end with _CL (e.g. AbstractEventLogs_CL).
3-44 chars: letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, periods.
3-64 chars: letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, periods.

elements.name: tableColumnsJson
elements.label: Custom table columns (JSON; optional)
elements.toolTip: Leave [] to use the generated Abstract ACS schema. To override, enter a JSON array such as [{"name":"TimeGenerated","type":"datetime"},{"name":"Message","type":"string"}]. Include TimeGenerated with type datetime.

elements.name: customTablePlan
elements.label: Abstract table plan
elements.toolTip: Analytics runs analytics rules and the Abstract content pack. Auxiliary is the Sentinel data lake tier: cheap long retention and KQL jobs, but no analytics rules or alerts. Basic sits between them. Azure does not allow changing an existing Analytics table to Auxiliary.

elements.name: sourceRoutes
elements.label: Parse these sources into their vendor tables (optional)
elements.toolTip: For each source selected, the rule unpacks the event's raw record and runs that vendor's published Microsoft Sentinel connector parsing into the vendor's own table. Install the vendor's Content Hub solution for its parsers, rules and workbooks. Every event still lands in the Abstract table.

elements.name: enableDcrErrorLogs
elements.label: Log ingestion errors to the workspace (DCRLogErrors)
elements.toolTip: Records why Azure refused a request or dropped a row. Without it these failures show only as metric counts.

options.text: The supplied user-assigned identity runs the provisioning script; it is separate from Abstract's runtime app. Before deployment, a Global Administrator must grant the provisioning identity Microsoft Graph Application.ReadWrite.All (AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All is not needed) with admin consent once per tenant. With no Key Vault, no secret is generated; create one in Entra after deployment and copy its value once.

elements.name: managedIdentityResourceId
elements.label: User-assigned managed identity resource ID
elements.toolTip: Full resource ID of a user-assigned managed identity. It can be in a different subscription or resource group. Format: /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/<name>

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the full resource ID of a user-assigned managed identity.

elements.name: appDisplayName
elements.label: Entra app display name
elements.toolTip: Display name for the app registration created for Abstract. Reused if one with this name already exists.

elements.name: secretValidityYears
elements.label: Client secret validity
elements.toolTip: How long the generated client secret is valid.

elements.name: keyVaultMode
elements.label: Client secret storage
elements.toolTip: Choose where the generated client secret is stored. None does not create a secret; you create it in Entra after deployment.

allowedValues.label: Skip Key Vault; create secret manually in Entra

elements.name: keyVaultName
elements.label: Key Vault name (leave empty to auto-generate)
elements.toolTip: Name of the new Key Vault. Empty = auto-generate abstract-kv-<hash>. Must be globally unique.

constraints.validationMessage: 3-24 chars, lowercase letters/numbers/hyphens, start with a letter — or empty to auto-generate.

elements.name: existingKeyVaultResourceId
elements.label: Existing Key Vault resource ID
elements.toolTip: Full resource ID of an existing Key Vault. The provisioning identity needs Key Vault Secrets Officer at that vault's scope.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the full resource ID of an existing Key Vault.

elements.name: secretName
elements.label: Key Vault secret name
elements.toolTip: Used only when Key Vault is enabled.

elements.name: forceSecretRotation
elements.label: Force client secret rotation
elements.toolTip: Only use for a planned rotation. Update Abstract with the new secret value.

elements.name: secretReaderObjectId
elements.label: Secret reader object ID (optional)
elements.toolTip: Object ID of a user or group to grant 'Key Vault Secrets User' so they can read the generated secret to paste into Abstract. Leave empty to grant no reader.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a GUID (object id) or empty.
